name: npi-provider-mcp
description: US healthcare provider lookup and NPI verification from the CMS NPPES NPI Registry.
long_description: US healthcare provider lookup and NPI verification from the official CMS NPPES NPI Registry API v2.1: NPI lookup, provider search, NPI check-digit validation and taxonomy codes. Public data, no API key needed.

tools.name: lookup_npi
tools.description: Get the full NPPES registry record for one 10-digit NPI (National Provider Identifier).

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search US healthcare providers in the NPPES NPI Registry.

tools.name: validate_npi
tools.description: Validate an NPI: format, check digit and registry status.

tools.name: specialty_codes
tools.description: Find healthcare provider taxonomy (specialty) codes and descriptions by keyword, as used in the NPPES registry.
